column7: #3554 review follow-up 3: a failed SetUserRoles reverted its partial apply through AssignUserRole, whose #3546 scope check refused to restore a legacy (pre-#3546) global project-role grant it had just removed, silently dropping it. The revert now restores exactly that (role, scope) (withRoleScopeRestore; TestRoleScopeRestoreMarker_CoversOnlyItsOwnGrant).
